content.comment_body: I attempted to use the 4-20mA input option on the [product_name] analog expansion module for a pressure transmitter. For testing, I connected the input on [product_name] to a 24V power supply using a resistor to provide 8 mA of current. It functioned briefly, then stopped working as no current flowed. I tried the second input; the same issue occurred, and the module appears to be damaged. [company_name] does not offer a detailed wiring diagram for these modules, so I'm unsure about the correct connections. Should the M terminal connect to the negative (ground)? Does anyone have more information? Thank you in advance/[user_name]
Hello [user_name], perhaps this wiring diagram from [company_name] can help you: [url]. I believe this diagram is usually packed with a new [product_name] module. Regards, [user_name]

Thank you, that’s very helpful. I’m still unsure about the purpose of the resistor between the power supply and the positive terminal of the [product_name] module. Does anyone know? Best regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], In my view, it might not be a resistor but possibly a fuse. Best regards, [user_name]
That makes sense. I’ll try connecting a new [product_name] module I received today and hope it works properly this time. Thanks everyone/[user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced failure of the [product_name] analog module after connecting a pressure transmitter via a testing setup, emphasizing unclear wiring instructions. The absence of accessible wiring diagrams contributed to misconnection and damage. Users debated the roles of circuit elements, such as resistor versus fuse, reflecting confusion due to unclear documentation and limited support material.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking straightforward wiring guidance, including diagrams and clear instructions about the necessary circuit components to safely and reliably connect a pressure transmitter to the [product_name] module.
